parrafo_2.en: Every visit is built around what your body needs: manual massage, machine work, hot stones, EMS, or a combination with honey massage and a body wrap for body care and anti-cellulite work.

items.quote: Regina gave me one of the best treatments I ever received. She is very attuned, the pressure was perfect and her technique so good!! Loved the EMS and hot stones too. I'm definitely coming back.

This was amazing! I did a combo of manual, machine, and honey massages plus a body wrap. I noticed a visible difference in volume right away and my skin feels incredibly smooth. My body contour looks more toned and my skin is glowing.

I would like to thank massage therapist Regina! She is a true professional, attentive, caring, and very responsive to her clients' needs. Thanks to her work, I feel so much better. I will definitely be coming back again!

notas_variante_adaptada.sin_precios_publicados: No price list found on the square.site booking page (no $ amounts in page source) nor in any directory. Services shown without price + note 'call for pricing'.
notas_variante_adaptada.sin_instagram: No Instagram or Facebook account found for this business after search. The ig_url/ig_handle slot is reused for the Google Maps listing (real, verifiable, where the 36 five-star reviews live), labeled 'Google Reviews' instead of Instagram.
notas_variante_adaptada.fotos: Only 2 usable photos came from the Google Maps scraper; the square.site booking page (rislana-studio.square.site) hosted 11 real photos in its gallery section, of which one was an AI-generated ChatGPT image (excluded) and two were close-up nude/glamour-style shots not appropriate for a public gallery per the no-compromising-photos rule (excluded). 6 remaining photos (massage technique, body wrap, facial, studio ambience) were kept, verified and resized.
